about: ChitBridge country comparison of accounting packages, one flat rows[] list like compat.json so the Standards page can load it into CBList. status: ahead|level|behind|n/a. checked (per row): the date the row was last held against its source; source_url: the first official page in source. verified: source = the claim is in the cited source (for India, 2026-10-24: every theirs read on the vendor's own help or pricing page, every ours read in our code); memory = the cited doc says 'from knowledge' or the sources are silent, check before external use. Not covered: Busy, Marg, Odoo, FTA-accredited UAE packs (no source in docs), and any UAE VAT, bank, multi-currency or inventory claim. Rows are left out where sources say nothing. The ours column was re-read against what main ships on 2026-11-19 (api 8f569e87, web after #758); the theirs column and each row's own `checked` date are as last held against the vendor's page (theirs was not re-checked on 2026-11-19). A status changes only with a route or screen on main and a green test on a SIT box (PR table).

rows.theirs: GL, invoices, bills, fixed assets, reports on every plan
rows.ours: Double-entry books with the Australian chart and GST codes: trial balance, profit and loss, balance sheet, fixed assets and depreciation, a closed month is locked, a year can be closed.

rows.theirs: GST + BAS on every plan; lodge from Xero Tax via ATO
rows.ours: The BAS (Simpler BAS, or the full labels on request) is prepared from the posted books of the quarter, and a GST close and payment are posted. Not lodged: nothing is sent to the tax office from here.

rows.theirs: Direct feeds from major AU banks; JAX match suggestions
rows.ours: A bank statement file (CSV or JSON) is read, matched to the books and to payments already on the rail; a person accepts each match, nothing posts itself; accepted lines post through the normal entry door, and the reconciliation is signed and kept. No live bank feed.
rows.better: Two words: MATCHED vs RECONCILED (Xero blurs them)

rows.theirs: Comprehensive plan and up only
rows.ours: Foreign-currency bills post at the rate of their day; a payment settles at its own day's rate with the gain or loss on its own ledger; at month end open foreign balances are revalued and the revaluation reverses next day. Rates are typed or imported, never fetched.

rows.theirs: Up to 4000 items; no BOM, no serial or lot; add-ons for real stock
rows.ours: Movement log, weighted average, lots with expiry and first-expiry-first-out.
rows.better: Lots are native, not an add-on

rows.theirs: Supplier bill is a PDF read by OCR (Hubdoc); invoice sits in another company file
rows.ours: Supplier chit IS the bill: structured, matched to the order and the receipt, with a dispute route.
rows.better: Bills arrive coded; disputes are a trail, not an e-mail chase

rows.theirs: Balance sheet, profit and loss, trial balance, day book, ledgers and cash flow.
rows.ours: Double-entry books with balance sheet, profit and loss and trial balance. An entry is reversed, never edited; a closed month is locked.

rows.theirs: GSTR-1 is filed from TallyPrime itself with EVC or DSC (Release 5.0). GSTR-3B is downloaded, reconciled and uploaded from TallyPrime, then filed and paid on the GST portal.
rows.ours: GSTR-1 and GSTR-3B are prepared from the posted books, ready to upload. Nothing is filed from here yet.

rows.theirs: The IRN is generated from the sales entry through Tally’s own GSP; the invoice prints with the IRN and QR code; bulk generation too.
rows.ours: The e-invoice (IRN) file is built from the invoice and checked before anyone sends it. No connection to the e-invoice portal yet, so nothing is sent from here.

rows.theirs: Bank statements in Excel, CSV or MT940 are imported and matched automatically (Release 6.0, 145 or more banks). With Connected Banking some banks’ statements arrive directly.
rows.ours: A bank statement file (CSV or JSON) is read and matched to the books and to payments already on the rail. Every suggestion is confirmed by a person; accepted lines post through the normal entry door; the reconciliation is signed and kept. No live bank link.
rows.better: A payment already on the rail explains its statement line before anyone types.

rows.theirs: A base currency plus any foreign currencies, exchange rates by date, forex gain or loss worked out automatically.
rows.ours: A shop can book foreign-currency bills at the rate of their day; a payment settles at its own day's rate with the gain or loss worked out and posted; month-end revaluation of open foreign balances reverses next day. Rates are typed or imported, never fetched.

rows.theirs: An Edit Log records every change and deletion of a voucher (and of ledgers, stock items and groups). In the Edit Log edition it cannot be switched off; in the regular edition it can.
rows.ours: The books only add a line: an entry is reversed, never changed. Each entry names the rule version it was posted under, the period pack is sealed with a checksum, and every bank-match mark is kept with who and when.
rows.better: Nothing to switch on or off: a change is impossible, not merely logged.

rows.theirs: A supplier’s invoice can arrive over Bharat Connect and be accepted into a purchase entry, and payment details go back the same way. Otherwise the buyer keys the supplier’s invoice in. Each side keeps its own copy.
rows.ours: Buyer and seller hold the same sealed chit. It is matched to the order and the receipt, and a dispute is a thread on the line, not an e-mail chase.
rows.better: One record for both parties, not two copies exchanged.

rows.theirs: Masters and vouchers move in and out as XML or JSON files, or in from Excel with a column map. Bank transactions cannot be imported from Excel.
rows.ours: We read your stock items and company details from Tally over its XML port and send each sale and receipt to Tally as a voucher; the month's entries can be written as Tally files. Tested on a real TallyPrime for stock items and a receipt; sales vouchers tested on a stand-in so far. Your Tally trial balance can be read beside ours from an export file. Moving a whole set of books in is built for Xero and QuickBooks files only; not yet for Tally.

rows.theirs: Profit and loss, balance sheet and cash flow reports; bank reconciliation and GST reports on every plan, the Free plan included.
rows.ours: Double-entry books with balance sheet, profit and loss and trial balance. An entry is reversed, never edited; a closed month is locked.

rows.theirs: GSTR-1 and GSTR-3B are pushed to the GST portal from Zoho Books (Zoho is a GSP). GSTR-1 can be filed from Zoho Books or on the portal; GSTR-3B is filed and paid on the portal.
rows.ours: GSTR-1 and GSTR-3B are prepared from the posted books, ready to upload. Nothing is filed from here yet.

rows.theirs: Invoices go straight to the e-invoice portal through Zoho’s own GSP and come back with the IRN and QR code. On every paid plan from Standard.
rows.ours: The e-invoice (IRN) file is built from the invoice and checked before anyone sends it. No connection to the e-invoice portal yet, so nothing is sent from here.

rows.theirs: Automatic bank feeds through Yodlee or Token for supported banks, up to 90 days back; statements in CSV, TSV, OFX, QIF, CAMT.053 or PDF can be imported; matching with rules.
rows.ours: A bank statement file (CSV or JSON) is read and matched to the books and to payments already on the rail. Every suggestion is confirmed by a person; accepted lines post through the normal entry door; the reconciliation is signed and kept. No live bank link.
rows.better: A payment already on the rail explains its statement line before anyone types.

rows.theirs: Transactions in other currencies from the Professional plan; exchange rates fetched automatically or typed by hand.
rows.ours: A shop can book foreign-currency bills at the rate of their day; a payment settles at its own day's rate with the gain or loss worked out and posted; month-end revaluation of open foreign balances reverses next day. Rates are typed or imported, never fetched. Not built: rates fetched automatically.

rows.theirs: An activity log and audit trail keep every version of a transaction, with who changed what and when. No user or admin can change the log.
rows.ours: The books only add a line: an entry is reversed, never changed. Each entry names the rule version it was posted under, the period pack is sealed with a checksum, and every bank-match mark is kept with who and when.
rows.better: Nothing to switch on or off: a change is impossible, not merely logged.

rows.theirs: A vendor portal: your vendor accepts or declines your purchase order and uploads a bill as a PDF or image (5 MB), which you accept into a bill. The portal is a shared window; each side keeps its own books.
rows.ours: Buyer and seller hold the same sealed chit. It is matched to the order and the receipt, and a dispute is a thread on the line, not an e-mail chase.
rows.better: One record for both parties, not two copies exchanged.

rows.theirs: Invoices, bills, items and contacts import from CSV, TSV or XLS files (10 MB). A REST API with OAuth covers every module: 100 calls a minute, 1,000 a day on Free.
rows.ours: Our connector reads your items from Zoho Books through its API and can send sales invoices and payments to it; its sign-in refreshes on its own. Written from Zoho's published API and tested on a stand-in, not yet on a live Zoho organisation. Not built: importing invoices, bills and contacts from Zoho files, and moving your Zoho books into ChitBridge.
